english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for becoming airborne, and it can also mean jumping off something when the downward direction is clear from context.
This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for jumping or leaping.

examples.english: Let's jump into the water together.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 tiu3 lok6 seoi2 laa1

examples.english: I had to leap away as soon as I saw that dog.
examples.traditional: 我一見到隻狗就跳開咗。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 zek3 gau2 zau6 tiu3 hoi1 zo2
